services.heading: A better website. Help keeping it that way.

items.title: Website design & development
items.text: Up to five pages that explain your services and show your work, with light editing of the content you provide. Built for desktop, tablet, and mobile.

items.title: Contact forms & analytics
items.text: Make it easy to call, request an estimate, or book through your existing service. Basic analytics help you understand your website traffic.

items.title: Ongoing care, if you need it
items.text: Optional hosting, SSL, maintenance, and monthly checks. Includes a monthly summary and up to 30 minutes of content updates each month.

services.personal_note: Work directly with John Choi, from the first prototype to launch.

steps.title: See your free prototype
steps.text: Share your website or a business summary. John emails a working preview within 72 hours of reaching out.

steps.title: Agree on the plan
steps.text: If you want to continue, we put the pages, scope, price, payment schedule, and build timeline in writing.

steps.title: Review, then launch
steps.text: Two rounds of revisions are included. We launch after your approval and final payment. Ongoing care is optional.
